purpose: Per-user normal-motion baseline used to convert the 26 engineered features into 14 baseline-ratio features.

privacy.note: The baseline is user-specific and stored on-device; it is never uploaded (FD-1, FD-2).

calibration.note: The Motion ML training pipeline constructs the per-user normal-motion baseline from 20 normal/frustration-free windows. The notebook does not define a mobile runtime duration, storage format, or recalibration policy.

ratio_computation.note: Current-window engineered features are expressed as ratios relative to the corresponding baseline statistics to produce the 14 personalized features. Exact ratio definition per feature depends on ML-D8 (feature list) and the training pipeline.
